Details
  • Paper: FastViT: A Fast Hybrid Vision Transformer using Structural Reparameterization, ICCV 2023, 2023-03-24
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/apple/ml-fastvit (PyTorch): timm carries the architecture and the apple_dist_in1k weights in its own, simpler API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: LicenseRef-Apple-Sample-Code
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k/blob/0b86f2b98f83274e9f03b6ddbcb3942b84efb839/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Licence note: The weights are under Apple's sample-code licence (the timm Hugging Face card says only 'license: other'); that licence grants no patent rights.
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k (default of fastvit_sa24), fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k, fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 256x256: the input is resized (short side 284) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k 256x256 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k 256x256 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k 256x256 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
  • fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k 256x256, first call: portable + torch.compile 8 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 54 s (ONNX + engine).
  • fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k 256x256, first call: portable + torch.compile 7 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 31 s (ONNX + engine).
  • fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k 256x256, first call: portable + torch.compile 7 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 40 s (ONNX + engine).
  • fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k original (fp32) 256x256: timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k original 256x256: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k original (fp32) 256x256: timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k original 256x256: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k original (fp32) 256x256: timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k original 256x256: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; timm FastViT with authors' reparameterized inference recipe; fusion is outside the timed call
  • fastvit_sa24.apple_dist_in1k load / first call: original 0.31 s / 0.028 s (256x256), portable 3.4 s / 0.585 s (256x256), kernels 2.3 s / 0.002 s (256x256)
  • fastvit_t8.apple_dist_in1k load / first call: original 0.21 s / 0.976 s (256x256), portable 1.76 s / 0.548 s (256x256), kernels 1.95 s / 0.045 s (256x256)
  • fastvit_t12.apple_dist_in1k load / first call: original 0.14 s / 0.708 s (256x256), portable 1.81 s / 0.406 s (256x256), kernels 2.01 s / 0.044 s (256x256)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
